$comment: Index of the current BLE peripheral firmware release. Update version and release tag when you cut a firmware release. hex = complete application-core image, net = nRF5340 network-core image, bin = complete ESP32 flash image. FOTA images are not published: the EMBIoT Toolkit application carries them. The EMBIoT Toolkit application does NOT read this file (it has no network access) — it exists for the documentation and any release tooling.
